# Naismith

> @NaismithAIApp (https://x.com/NaismithAIApp) posts free NBA injury alerts on X for fantasy basketball. Each alert shows the injured player's fantasy points per game and up to three pickups, tagged by league size.

Last updated: 2026-11-10

## Facts

- Free. No app, no account. Alerts are on X; naismithai.com has a player-lookup dashboard.
- Posts when a player is ruled out, listed doubtful or questionable, gets a new timeline, or leaves a game. If he returns within about four hours, it replies under that post.
- Pickup tags, by projected fantasy points per game gained while the injured player is out: All leagues (+8 or more), 12+ team (+5 to +8), Deep league (+3 to +5). Pickups under +3 aren't listed. Players averaging 32+ aren't suggested.
- Sources: the official NBA injury report, ESPN, RotoWire, CBS Sports, Bluesky, and NBA insiders and beat writers on X. Shams Charania and Underdog NBA are checked about every 90 seconds, other main insiders every 10 minutes, beat writers about every 50 minutes.
- An AI model writes each one-line summary. Code checks it against the original report and rejects any team, day, body part or timeline the report doesn't contain. Mistakes still happen.
- A recap thread follows each night's games: top performers, breakouts and minutes to watch, with full stat lines.
- Scoring: points 1, rebounds 1.2, assists 1.5, steals 3, blocks 3, three-pointers 0.5, turnovers -1.
- Not affiliated with the NBA.

## Alert format

🚨 Star Guard (TEAM) — OUT (2-3 weeks) | 41 FPTS/g
The team says he'll be re-evaluated in two weeks.
🔥 Backup Guard (+8.4 FPTS/g) — All leagues
🎯 Bench Wing (+5.6 FPTS/g) — 12+ team
📰 Shams Charania
